## What you need

- **Must (headline):** AppSec & threat modelling, Python (production), OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, SSO, Incident response & SIEM, LLM security (prompt injection, OWASP).
- **Important (headline):** Prompt-injection attack & defence, Agent abuse & MCP authorisation, Model supply chain & CVEs, Containment (DLP, sandboxing, egress), Red-teaming, GRC & risk assessment, AWS / Azure / GCP.
- **Full inventory:** 49 skills (Must 7 · Important 14 · Should 19 · Optional 9), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ai-security-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ai-security-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Application-security background; Anthropic AI Security Fellow requires US/UK/Canada work authorisation [A · T0-12]
- **Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills):** ISC2 CISSP (Optional: established security credential). Whether one is worth it: [credential ROI](../../04-certifications/credential-roi.md).
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** A red-team suite in CI against a working agent, with attack-success rates before and after mitigation; an MCP security audit
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P10 Red-team suite in CI against a working agent](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p10) (48%); [P6 Self-hosted LLM platform on Kubernetes](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p6) (28%); [P2 Reliable agent: approvals, sandboxed tools, replay, failure injection](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p2) (28%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).
